# permio_group_members (Resource)

The complete member list of a group. This resource is **authoritative**: on every apply it adds the listed principals and removes any other member of the group, including members added outside Terraform. Destroying it removes every member from the group (the group itself is kept).

Use at most one `permio_group_members` per group, and do not combine it with `permio_group_member` on the same group: the two would keep undoing each other's changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "permio_group" "engineering" {
  name = "engineering"
}

# Authoritative: these are the group's only members. Anyone else is removed.
resource "permio_group_members" "engineering" {
  group = permio_group.engineering.name
  members = [
    "user_alice",
    "user_bob",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Name (slug) of the group, for example `permio_group.engineering.name`.
- `members` (Set of String) Principal IDs of all members. An empty set removes every member. Group principals (`group:...`) are not allowed, because groups cannot be nested.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the object. API keys are scoped to one project, so this must be the key's project.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project>/<group>`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by "<project>/<group>" or by "<group>".
terraform import permio_group_members.engineering default/engineering
```
